Here are online beauty stores that are consistently “best” across the GCC (good authenticity, range, delivery/returns, and customer experience). I’m focusing on retailers that serve **multiple GCC countries** or are **top-tier in the biggest markets (KSA/UAE)**.

## Best all-around (prestige + mainstream)
- **Sephora Middle East** (UAE/KSA and wider GCC presence): best for prestige makeup/skincare, sets, and brand launches; generally the safest bet for authenticity. ([harpersbazaararabia.com](https://www.harpersbazaararabia.com/hbanews/best-beauty-brands-sephora-middle-east?utm_source=openai))  
- **FACES (Wojooh)**: strong prestige mix (makeup + fragrance), frequent promos, popular across the Gulf. ([couponatt.com](https://couponatt.com/faces-wajoh-vs-sephora-best-beauty-cosmetics-perfume-store-online-gulf-2026/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Ounass**: luxury “beauty hall” experience—great for higher-end skincare, fragrance, and gifting (especially UAE/KSA). ([thenationalnews.com](https://www.thenationalnews.com/lifestyle/15-beauty-websites-that-offer-speedy-delivery-to-the-uae-1.878729?utm_source=openai))  

## Best for deals + fast delivery (marketplace/superstore style)
- **noon (Beauty)**: huge selection and aggressive pricing; best when the listing is **sold by noon / official stores** (marketplace sellers can vary). ([noon.com](https://www.noon.com/uae-en/beauty/?utm_source=openai))  

## Best for Saudi Arabia (KSA) specifically (big catalogs + strong pricing)
- **Nice One**: one of the largest KSA-focused beauty e-retailers; strong for makeup + personal care + fragrance in one basket. ([hassalna.com](https://www.hassalna.com/en/uae/blog/nice-one-vs-faces-online-beauty-gulf?utm_source=openai))  
- **Golden Scent**: particularly strong for **fragrance** (including lots of niche/Arabic fragrance). ([code-khasem.com](https://code-khasem.com/ar-sa/blog/golden-scent-vs-nice-one-which-one-is-better?utm_source=openai))  

## Best “health & beauty retailer” option (omnichannel)
- **Watsons** (UAE, Bahrain, KSA, Qatar): great for drugstore skincare/haircare and K-beauty selections, with a more controlled retail supply chain than pure marketplaces. ([alfuttaim.com](https://www.alfuttaim.com/en/our-brands/watsons/?utm_source=openai))  

## Best for skincare specialists
- **BasharaCare** (UAE-based, ships regionally): reputable for dermatologist-style skincare brands and curated routines. ([basharacare.com](https://www.basharacare.com/ae_en/home?utm_source=openai))  

---

### Quick way to choose
- Want **guaranteed authenticity + prestige brands** → **Sephora / FACES / Ounass**
- Want **best prices** (and you can check seller/ratings) → **noon**
- You’re in **Saudi** and want the biggest local options → **Nice One / Golden Scent**
- Want **drugstore + pharmacy-style beauty** → **Watsons**
- Want **skincare-first specialist** → **BasharaCare**

If you tell me **which GCC country you’re in**, and what you buy most (fragrance vs makeup vs skincare/K-beauty), I’ll shortlist the top 3 and what each is best for.
